usageNotes: Returns the firewall directory index for a specific SDN VNet, listing the available firewall sub-resources (typically 'rules' and 'ipset'). Use this as a discovery step before querying firewall rules or IP sets scoped to the VNet. SDN must be enabled in the cluster and the target VNet must already exist.

examples.summary: List firewall sub-resources for SDN VNet 'webapp1'

tips: VNet identifiers are 2–8 alphanumeric characters starting with a letter; they are distinct from bridge names created on nodes.
This endpoint only lists available sub-resources (directory index); follow child links to 'rules' or 'ipset' endpoints to read or manage actual firewall entries.
SDN firewall rules at the VNet level are separate from node-level and VM-level firewall rules — changes here affect all traffic traversing the VNet.
